CREATE SEQUENCE goal_response_seq allocates response generations and rewrites no table. No backfill, sample rows or destructive data step. ALTER POLICY, CHECK replacement and CREATE SEQUENCE are outside the expand-safe allowlist. Exact bytes require coordinator cross-family review and whole-chain previous-binary compatibility/backup gates before merge or release. This artifact grants no acceptance, push or deployment authority. Round 3 keeps the same invoker predicates while constraining goal/outcome identity probes and checking event references by indexed identity in aeon_event_refs_visible; this avoids hashing every visible outcome for a watermark. Null/empty reference arrays and every existing event family retain their prior semantics. Outcome serves visibility likewise checks at most twenty target identities without a correlated anti-join, retaining the cycle/depth guard and restoration of project visibility; event subjects use the same invoker identity helper. The original non-outcome NOT IN shortcut is retained so ordinary-node planner choices remain unchanged.
